# agents

The reinforcement-learning agents, constructables over the contracts of `rl`: tabular and deep value-based learners, policy gradients and actor-critics, distributional, model-based and planning agents, offline, imitation, hierarchical, safe and exploration methods, multi-agent learners and bandit agents. All follow the agent contract of `lib/rl`, so any of them can be trained and evaluated on any environment whose spaces it supports.

- table `banditStrategies`: Bandit strategies as one slot. `src/lib/agents/bandits.ts:938` `omai-engine/agents`

- agent `dqn`: Deep Q-network agent. `src/lib/agents/value-based.ts:300` `omai-engine/agents`
- agent `dreamer`: Dreamer world-model agent. `src/lib/agents/model-based.ts:488` `omai-engine/agents`
- agent `mctsAgent`: Monte Carlo tree search planning agent. `src/lib/agents/planning.ts:297` `omai-engine/agents`
- agent `ppo`: Proximal policy optimisation; REINFORCE, A2C and TRPO beside it. `src/lib/agents/policy-gradient.ts:636` `omai-engine/agents`
- agent `qLearning`: Tabular Q-learning; SARSA and Dyna-Q beside it. `src/lib/agents/tabular.ts:212` `omai-engine/agents`
- agent `ucb1`: UCB1 bandit agent; Thompson and EXP3 beside it. `src/lib/agents/bandits.ts:219` `omai-engine/agents`
